4 افاح He poured forth, spilled, or shed, blood. (S, Msb, K.) See also 1, first sentence. ―
-b2- افاح القِدْرَ (assumed tropical:) He made the cooking-pot to boil. (S, K.) ―
-b3- أَفِحْ عَنْكَ مِنَ الظَّهِيرَةِ i. q. أَبْرِدْ, (K,) i. e. (assumed tropical:) Stay thou until the mid-day heat shall have become assuaged, and the air be cool: (M, L, TA:) [as also افِخْ:] the medial radical letter is both و and ى. (M.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
